title: Restrictions for Use of DeepSeek by Public Officers
what_it_is: Restrictions for Use of DeepSeek by Public Officers

sections.label: DeepSeek restrictions for public officers
sections.summary: Asked whether Singapore restricts DeepSeek for public officers, what justifies a different approach, and how AI models are deemed secure for public sector use.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Digital Development and Information (a) whether the Government is considering restrictions on the use of DeepSeek by public officers, similar to bans imposed by some other countries on its use on Government devices; (b) if not, what factors justify a different approach in Singapore; and (c) how does the Government determine which AI models are deemed secure enough for public sector use.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: This allows us to evaluate the suitability of technologies for different use cases, based on factors such as performance, security and resilience.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: This enables public sector agencies to use innovative technologies effectively while ensuring the security and reliability of government operations and functions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: We regularly review and update our policies to address the evolving technological landscape and security considerations.

sections.label: Government comment on commercial products
sections.summary: The Government does not generally comment on specific commercial products and advises companies to evaluate products on their own merits and risks.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The Government does not generally comment on specific commercial products.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We advise companies to evaluate products on their own merits and the risks of use, including their compliance with relevant laws.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Pair does indeed access large language models, but it does not access only one.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The specific details of Pair, I do not have them on hand.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: If Mr Giam is interested in the technical details, I would be happy to follow up with him offline or he can file a subsequent Parliamentary Question.
